desc: Parse input efficiently and compute M = max(query X).

Implement difference-array + Fenwick (BIT) with base=F[1]=1, D[1..M-1]=1, total=M-1; per contest locate a (first F>=L) and b (last F<=R) via Fenwick lower_bound, apply base/D point updates; answer queries via base+prefixD(X-1).
Test on Samples 1-3 and edge cases (X=1, M=1, L=R, never/always matching intervals) — all passed.
Output Q answers, one per line, to stdout.
Performance is O((N+Q) log M) which is well within limits for N=2e5, Q=3e5, M=5e5.
